en.name: Kinnav
en.subtitle: Safety, support and self-care
en.short_description: Personal safety for women: emergency dialling, safety contacts and self-care.
en.description:
Kinnav is a personal safety and wellbeing companion built for women.

Getting home late. Walking to the car after a shift. A first date in an unfamiliar part of town. Kinnav is designed for the moments when you want someone with you, and a way to feel steadier the rest of the time.

EMERGENCY DIALLING
A confirmed one-tap route to 911. Kinnav is not a replacement for emergency services and never tries to be — when you need police, fire, or an ambulance, the app puts you straight through.

SAFE CALL
Tap CALL GUARDIANS and choose voice, video, text or emergency. Live calls and chat with guardians are not available yet, and Safe Call says so plainly: it puts you one tap from emergency services and opens a text to your safety contacts, with your location when your phone can provide it.

SAFETY CONTACTS
Keep the people who matter one tap away.

YOUR LOCATION
The home screen shows your current location. A street map is not available yet. Guardians will appear there once the guardian network is live; until then it shows no one.

SELF-CARE TOPICS
Topic outlines for safety planning, self-defence and wellness. The full lessons are not in the app yet and are coming soon, along with communication, digital safety, and career and money.

BENEFITS
Partner benefits in wellness, fitness, counselling, career development, language learning and financial education are coming soon. None can be redeemed yet.

CALL HISTORY
Every Safe Call is recorded in your history so you have a record of what happened and when.

EARLY ACCESS
Kinnav is in early access. The guardian network is still being built: the app shows no guardians, does not connect you to a live responder, and does not yet offer guardian training. Emergency dialling, safety contacts and the text alert to them, and your location work today; the self-care modules are topic outlines for now. We would rather tell you exactly where we are than overpromise on an app you might need in a bad moment.

PRIVACY
Location is used to show your position on the home screen and, when you start a Safe Call, to include your position in the text to your safety contacts. Your account is protected and your data is encrypted in transit.

Kinnav shows ads from Google AdMob on the self-care topics and benefits screens. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The ads are non-tracking, and where the law requires it you are asked for consent first; you can change that choice in the app under About Us > Privacy choices. There are no ads on the map, Safe Call, safety contacts or call history screens. Read the full policy at https://kinnav.com/privacy

Questions or feedback: support@kinnav.com

en.release_notes:
The app now opens in your language whenever it is one Kinnav translates
(Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Hindi, Spanish), and falls back to English
otherwise instead of failing to start.

If your device cannot place the emergency call (for example an iPad or a phone
with no SIM), Kinnav now tells you to dial yourself instead of showing
"Police added".

The How to use guide, the in-app Terms and Privacy summaries and the self-care
topics now describe exactly what the app does today. Better screen-reader
labels on Safe Call, Call Options and your profile.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Kinnav is a personal safety and wellbeing companion built for women.

Intended audience:
Safety, support and self-care

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. Test credentials are in the demo account fields of App Review Information.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- device location services (on-device)
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints
- Google AdMob (ads)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
